title: Control ticket consumed runtime event payload v0.2
description: ACAF Slice 1 (设计文档 §4.2/§4.5（ADR-0011 §2）): a ControlTicket passed all seven verification checks and was consumed for its control event. The event chain (previous_event_sha256) binds consumption to the issued event; the receipt chaining contract of §4.6 means a consumed ticket must have been issued in the same run.
